summary: Moved all rounding into meterbill/money.py (exact integer arithmetic, no decimal context), removed the context line, added tests; CLI output matched the original on fuzzed books/accounts. Context-dependent sites keep their old method: batch (pool threads) rounds band charges and per-kWh price half-even, bill/quote/tariffs half-up. Kept quirks: batch half-even, whole-rule zero prints 0 not -0.
